title: REQ · Config loading still works for the remaining keys and no code reads a removed key
summary: Remaining keys load with defaults and env overrides, and the shipped example config loads
description: Context: LoadFS applies defaults for auth, storage, contribution and round, and applyEnv overrides seven keys. Desired behavior: loading is unchanged after worker key removal. Expected result: the shipped config.example.yaml loads through Load with its documented values, and defaults still apply to a minimal file. Why: proves nothing needed by the server was lost.
acceptance_criteria: Given backend/configs/config.example.yaml, when config.Load reads it, then it returns no error with Server.Addr :8080, Round.Duration 24h and Contribution.MaxPromptLen 500
Given a YAML with only auth.token_secret, when LoadFS runs, then Round.SchedulerInterval is 30s, Storage.ContentDir is game/content and Contribution.RateMax is 3
Given the server and cmd packages, when they are searched, then no reference to a worker or execution config field exists

in_scope: Confirm LoadFS defaults, env overrides and main.go use only kept fields

technical_constraints: Use only fstest and the example file path relative to the package
